# 2. Remove C style comments (/* */)

# 4. Remove empty lines

  sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//g' | \  # Remove leading whitespace
  sed 's/[[:space:]]*$//g' | \  # Remove trailing whitespace
  sed '/^$/d' | \                # Remove empty lines
  sed 's/[[:space:]]\+/ /g' > /tmp/normalized.cpp  # Normalize multiple spaces to single space

echo "=== Normalized code ==="
cat /tmp/normalized.cpp
echo ""
echo "=== MD5 sum of normalized code ==="
md5sum /tmp/normalized.cpp | cut -d' ' -f1
